Create a NEW NOVICE adventurer emblem in the same fine fantasy heraldic style: a simple open book with two gracefully curved pages at bottom center, a small upright four-point guiding star above the book, and an incomplete thin circular arc suggesting an unexplored horizon. Output exactly one centered isolated emblem on a SQUARE canvas, artwork occupying about 76% of both axes, with generous equal transparent padding.
